claim.ja: 滑らかな連結複素射影Xで−K_Xがsmoothly semipositiveなら、あるm>0でH⁰(X,−mK_X)≠0。無正次数形式の多様体では、有限随伴体積と別の有界半正値線束から境界にのみ極を許す非消滅も示す。
claim.en: For smooth connected projective X with smoothly semipositive −K_X, some positive anticanonical power has a section. A no-forms finite-volume theorem also produces sections of a bounded semipositive target line with poles restricted to a boundary.

role.ja: 二計量の移送と次元帰納法で通常の非消滅を証明し、トーラス不変直像を通して自然不変切断を作る。有限被覆とnormは他稿にも幾何入力を供給する。
role.en: Two-metric transfer and dimension induction prove ordinary nonvanishing; an invariant direct-image argument produces naturally invariant sections. The finite cover and norm also supply geometric inputs to other manuscripts.

notes: No other catalogue-068 manuscript is a direct input in 01.
